assertions.assertion: Uses JsonWebTokenHandler.ReadJsonWebToken (or JwtSecurityTokenHandler) to parse the access token string
Asserts the client_id claim matches the test client's ID
assertions.rationale: Asserts "test-client" equals the client_id claim value.

assertions.assertion: Asserts the scope claim contains the expected scope value
assertions.rationale: Collects scope claims and Assert.Contains("api1", scopes).

assertions.assertion: Asserts the issuer (iss) claim matches the expected authority URL
assertions.rationale: Assert.Equal(disco.Issuer, jwt.Issuer) compares issuer to the authority from discovery.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT make a network call to validate the token — parses it locally
assertions.rationale: Token is decoded locally with ReadJwtToken (comment says no validation); no validation call is made.
